Calcul de Stabilité

The process of determining a vessel’s ability to remain upright and safe under current loading conditions by calculating stability parameters.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Calcul de Stabilité?

In this glossary, Calcul de Stabilité refers to: The process of determining a vessel’s ability to remain upright and safe under current loading conditions by calculating stability parameters.

How is Calcul de Stabilité used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Capitaine à l'autorité portuaire : Calcul de stabilité effectué, tous les paramètres répondent aux critères de sécurité de l'OMI avant le départ."

Why does Calcul de Stabilité matter in maritime?

Calcul de Stabilité matters because it supports clear communication in Cargo contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Calcul de Stabilité?

Calcul de Stabilité is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Calcul de Stabilité belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

The process of determining a vessel’s ability to remain upright and safe under current loading conditions by calculating stability parameters.

Operational example

Master to port authority: Stability calculation has been performed and all parameters meet IMO safety criteria prior to sailing.

Localized term

Calcul de Stabilité

Localized example
